The Federal Employee Retirement System (FERS) is a three-tiered retirement plan that includes Social Security benefits, the Basic Benefit Plan, and the Thrift Savings Plan (TSP). As an NIH employee, you pay full Social Security taxes and a small contribution to the Basic Benefit Plan.
